message.content: {"hts_code": "7326.90.8680", "reason": "An empty steel electrical junction box imported without any electrical components is considered an article of iron or steel, classified in HTSUS heading 7326 rather than as an electrical apparatus part."}
message.reasoning_content: Steel junction box — 7326.90? Boxes of iron/steel not of cast/forged... Actually electrical conduit boxes of steel classified 8536.90?
